cover:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished game cover / PSP XMB game icon master for the fan fighting game "死神 VS 火影", Bleach vs Naruto 3.7 Alpha.
Primary request: Draw an original premium anime fighting-game cover with Ichigo Kurosaki and Naruto Uzumaki in a tense face-to-face clash. Ichigo has spiky orange hair, black shihakusho robes and his oversized black sword; Naruto has spiky blond hair, Leaf forehead protector, whisker marks and black-and-orange Shippuden jacket. Keep their identities and costumes recognizable.
Style: polished hand-drawn anime key visual, bold cel shading, confident ink lines, sharp facial expressions, energetic but uncluttered.
Composition: horizontal 16:9, one complete flat cover image, no mockup or surrounding objects. Tight bust/shoulder framing, Ichigo on the left and Naruto on the right looking toward each other; strong diagonal slash between them. Both faces large enough to remain recognizable when the image is reduced to 144x80 pixels. Keep all faces within the inner 85% of frame. Dark indigo spiritual energy behind Ichigo, warm orange chakra behind Naruto, with a restrained teal-white center glow. Strong contrast, sparse sparks, no excessive tiny detail.
Text verbatim: "死神 VS 火影" in large, expertly designed bold white Chinese brush lettering across the lower quarter, with a dark outline for clarity. The title must be exact and readable. No extra text, no extra logos, no watermarks, no platform strip, no badges, no version numbers. Do not draw the console or a game box.
background:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: PSP XMB selection background (PIC1), finished flat landscape artwork, 16:9 composition that will be reduced to 480x272 pixels.
Reference image: the supplied cover is a style/color/character reference only. Create a distinct companion background, not a copy of the cover layout.
Primary request: An original Bleach vs Naruto game background in the same polished anime key-visual style. Ichigo Kurosaki with orange hair, black shihakusho robes and oversized black sword, and Naruto Uzumaki with blond hair, Leaf forehead protector, whisker marks and black-and-orange Shippuden jacket stand back to back in the RIGHTMOST 40 percent of the canvas. Show them from knees upward in calm ready-for-battle poses, both faces recognizable. Keep their heads away from the outer edge. Clean anatomy and natural grip.
Scene/backdrop: atmospheric night battlefield with faint traditional village roof silhouettes along the bottom, ink-like indigo mist, a restrained violet spiritual-energy ribbon around Ichigo and a warm orange chakra glow around Naruto. Polished cel-shaded characters, hand-painted night atmosphere.
Practical layout: the LEFT 58 percent must be low contrast dark navy-blue mist with generous empty space, because a real PSP menu will put icons and white game-title text there. No bright energy or character faces in that left safe area. Most vivid detail belongs at the far right. The upper and lower left should remain quiet, dark and readable.
Mood: dramatic, crisp, premium, matching the cover's indigo/violet/orange palette.
Constraints: no text of any kind, no title, no logos, no fake UI, no watermarks, no borders, no console or game box. One full-bleed background image.
